shortDescription: ChainOpera (COAI) is scheduled to unlock about 8.32 million tokens, valued at approximately $2.15 million, at 12:00 AM on October 25 (UTC+8). According to ChainCatcher, the figures come from Web3 asset data platform RootData's token-unlock data.

title: RootData: ChainOpera's COAI to Unlock $2.15M in Tokens in One Week
